- instantiate: ParameterNotInstantiableException (call1) and AssertionError (call2, but Error not caught). 
- testEqualsUsing: UnsupportedOperationException, IllegalArgumentException, ClassCastException (call3, call7), IndexOutOfBoundsException (call6), ParameterNotInstantiableException (call9), and AssertionFailedError (call4, call5, Errors).
